newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU fines five ferry companies after cartel probe.
newsitem.headline: EU fines five ferry companies after cartel probe.

text.p: The European Union said on Wednesday it had fined five ferry companies a total of 645,000 Ecus ($816,800) following a probe into allegations that they operated a price cartel in 1992.
The European Commission named the five companies in a statement as Peninsular & Oriental Steam Navigation Co, Stena-Sealink, Brittany Ferries, Sea France and North Sea Ferries.
P&O was given the biggest fine of 400,000 Ecus followed by Stena-Sealink which will have to pay 100,000 Ecus.
Brittany Ferries and Sea France were fined 60,000 Ecus each and North Sea Ferries 25,000. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800 ($1=.7897 Ecu)
